title: VISREASON: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
reasoning: The paper is focused on visual chain-of-thought reasoning, spatial grounding, and 3D-aware perception in multimodal large language models. While it evaluates 'Grounded Faithfulness,' this is a technical metric regarding whether a model's reasoning matches visual evidence, rather than an evaluation of religious faith, morals, or ethics.
